task.goal: What events do I have in the next week in Simple Calendar Pro? Assume the week starts from Monday. Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
task.final_summary: In the next week (Mon Oct 16 to Sun Oct 22, 2023, counting from the device date of Sun Oct 15 with weeks starting Monday) you have two events: Scrum meeting and Meet with Mia.
